scope: Actual production DOM event handlers in Linkedom; numerical geometry and source-plane checks. Not browser permission or CSS pixel-layout verification.
checks: Always-visible reference chest precedes equal-grid heart/US pair; four starting presets remain outside collapsed settings.
One Escape releases an active lock and held movement keys; trailing click cannot relock; explicit Control button works on its next first click.
Pending void-returning pointer-lock request is cancelled by a single Escape; late grant exits immediately.
Cancelled Promise-returning requests stay cancelled after late resolution or rejection.
Browser-native unlock alone clears keyboard motion and disarms scene click capture without affecting fullscreen.
Steering-pad pointer capture releases with one Escape and subsequent movement has no effect; unowned Escape remains available.
Blur / module exit cancel pending lock. Unsupported native capture reveals and focuses the steering-pad fallback.
All 12 donor starting planes retain center, contact origin and orientation while the main instrument is 60% shorter/narrower.
GL mesh transform and software fallback agree on reduced geometry and unchanged tip coordinates.
Actual rib, spine and reference-heart vertices remain inside both camera views at aspect ratios 0.38–1.5; no donor registration applied.
